cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Description
cl.x: Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact is a specialty solvent free, ready to use non porous primer designed for use over smooth and non-porous surfaces and substrates.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.c: Data sheet page 1: Uses
cl.l: Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact is applied in combination with suitable materials from Sikafloor, SikaTile, Davco and other relevant Sika product ranges. Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact is suitable for priming over the following fully binded and thoroughly cleaned surfaces:
s: Ceramic and porcelain tiles
Terazzo
PVC control leak flanges and metal drain flanges prior to waterproofing
Non-porous coatings
Sika waterbased vapour/moisture barriers such as
Sikalastic Moisture Seal and Sikafloor-158W Fast Barrier
Vinyl flooring (non cushion backed)
Sika acrylic membranes
Non porous construction boards and sheets.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Substrate Preparation
s: The substrate must have adequate strength, load bearing capacity, dimensional stability and be dry. All substratss must be clean, dry and free of residues which reduce adhesion, e.g. dust, dirt, oil, grease, wax, cleaning agents and loose particles. 100% solids epoxy must be applied more than 24hrs before Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact can be applied.
When applying over exisiting tiles ensure the tiles are well bonded. Glossy tiles should be sanded to remove the gloss finish.

When installing over old flooring/coatings Sika® recommends mechanical abrasion (sanding/grinding) be carried out to achieve fresh non-contaminated surface, with coating having a minimum pull off strength of 1.5MPa. This is to be followed by a thorough clean prior to installing Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact & subsequent Sika® products.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information > Waiting time to overcoating
cl.x: Before applying subsequent flooring products Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact must be completely dry (50min+ @ 23°C). Do not install products over wet or pooling Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact, Instead, brush the pooling product out and wait till dry. When priming resin backed stone allow primer to dry for 3 hours (at 23°C & 50% RH). In cool or cold climate drying time will be extended.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Application
s: Apply a single coat with a paint brush or medium nap paint roller or paint brush to provide a continuous coating to the substrate.
Allow primer to dry and harden prior to flooring, levelling, tiling or subsequent coatings.

cl.c: Data sheet page 3: Application Instructions > Cleaning Of Equipment
s: Tools and equipment can be cleaned with water prior to the material drying.
Dried product shall require mechanical removal.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Limitations Of Use
s: Test product in an inconspicuous areas first to ensure compatabilty. Bond testing is considered good practice and is recommended by Sika to verify product suitability prior to overcoating
Do not apply Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact over concrete surfaces, use a Sika porous primer
Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact should not be applied over solvent based finishes

Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact may only be applied over SikaTile® or Davco® acrylic membranes Sikafloor® 100% Solids Epoxy must be cured for at least 24hrs before the application of Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact.
Do not apply on damp or wet substrates
Polished or high gloss tiles shall be sanded or abraded to remove high gloss finish prior to application.
Ensure Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact is fully dry prior to subsequent applications of membranes and other coatings.
Not suitable over tiles and natural stone that have sealers previously applied.
When used over existing tile ensure tiles are sound and well bonded.
Do not use Sikafloor®-14 Prep N Prime Impact in areas or permanent water exposure. Ensure applications externally are applied over falls to wastes and avoid ponding.
For uses not mentioned in this document contact Sika Australia.
